title: 第11章：青山镇果然有问题！
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

房车跟着农用三轮车，在颠簸的土路上拐了几个弯。

前方豁然开朗。

一道三米高的围墙横在眼前，不是砖石，是厚重的铁皮拼接而成，上面焊满了尖锐的倒刺和盘绕的铁丝网。

每隔五十米，就矗立着一座简易的木制哨塔，上面有人影在晃动。

这就是青山镇。

老马的三轮车在巨大的铁门前停下，接着按了三下喇叭。

铁门发出刺耳的摩擦声，缓缓向内

林昊注意到，铁门后面还有一层坚固的铁栅栏门，两道门之间形成了一个十米左右的缓冲区。

瓮城，这完全就是瓮中捉鳖的设计，设计这个防御工事的人一看就是行内人！......

但下一秒，内层的栅栏门也跟着

赵铁柱的视线在两扇同时敞开的门之间扫过，虽没说话，但握着防爆叉的手捏得更紧了。

要么是极度自信，要么是就……请君入瓮！......

房车驶入镇子，街道比预想的要干净。

路两边有人在修补房屋的墙壁，有人推着独轮车运送泥土。

广场的角落，一小片土地被开垦出来，种着绿油油的蔬菜。

一切都井然有序，甚至带着一丝灾难前和平年代的影子。

但每个从房车旁经过的镇民，脸上都带着一种相似的表情。

不是麻木，也不是绝望，而是一种近乎于顺从的平静。

他们看见房车这个庞然大物，眼里只有一闪而过的好奇，随即就低下头，继续干自己的活。

车被引导到镇中心的广场。

一个穿着干净白衬衫，头发梳成一丝不苟的背头的中年男人，笑着迎了上来。

他身后跟着几个同样穿着民兵服的人，但气势明显不一样。

“欢迎，欢迎来到青山镇。我是这里的镇长，赵永年。”

赵永年伸出手，握手力度不大不小，笑容恰到好处。

林昊握上去的瞬间，系统面板在视野里闪了一下。

【扫描目标：赵永年】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The RV followed the agricultural tricycle and made several turns on the bumpy dirt road.

The front suddenly becomes clear.

A three-meter-high wall stood in front of me. It was not masonry, but made of thick iron sheets, welded with sharp barbs and coiled barbed wire.

Every fifty meters, a simple wooden sentry tower stood, with figures swaying above it.

This is Qingshan Town.

Lao Ma's tricycle stopped in front of the huge iron gate, and then honked the horn three times.

The iron door made a harsh friction sound and slowly moved inward.

Lin Hao noticed that there was a solid iron fence behind the iron gate, and a buffer zone of about ten meters was formed between the two gates.

Wengcheng, this is completely the design of catching a turtle in an urn. The person who designed this fortification is an expert at first glance!...

But the next second, the inner fence door also followed.

Zhao Tiezhu's eyes swept between the two doors that were opened at the same time. Although he did not speak, his hand holding the explosion-proof fork tightened.

Either he is extremely confident, or he is just... inviting you into the urn!...

The RV rolled into town and the streets were cleaner than expected.

On both sides of the road, people were repairing the walls of houses, and people were pushing wheelbarrows to transport soil.

In the corner of the square, a small piece of land was reclaimed and planted with green vegetables.

Everything was in order, even with a hint of the peaceful times before the disaster.

But every townie who passed by the RV had a similar expression on their face.

Not numbness, not despair, but a kind of calm that is almost resigned.

When they saw the huge RV, there was only a flash of curiosity in their eyes, and then they lowered their heads and continued to do their work.

The car was guided to the square in the center of the town.

A middle-aged man wearing a clean white shirt and his hair combed back meticulously came up to him with a smile.

Behind him were several people also wearing militia uniforms, but their aura was obviously different.

"Welcome, welcome to Qingshan Town. I am the mayor here, Zhao Yongnian."

Zhao Yongnian stretched out his hand, shaking hands with moderate strength and smiling just right.

The moment Lin Hao held it, the system panel flashed in his field of vision.

[Scan target: Zhao Yongnian]
